question: Does the distinct Huihui v2 UD-IQ4_XS profile on Strata justify a larger adoption holdout versus the retained ASTRA Flash-Next RCO IQ2_XS profile on the user’s dual RTX 3090 + 128 GiB RAM host?
comparison_type: Full-profile comparison; same Strata Qwen engine 0.1.50, dual 3090s, context, KV, sampler and harness. Quantization/fine-tune differs by design; no weights-only attribution.
control: Existing ASTRA Qwen3.8 Flash-Next RCO IQ2_XS, exact local GGUF/pack/MTP checksums captured before use; MTP disabled in both arms for this first comparison because Huihui’s matching draft weights are not established.

candidate.license_metadata: qwen-community-1.0 (repo cardData); LICENSE path returned 404 at this revision; internal non-commercial evaluation per user instruction.

throughput_screen.after_artifact_and_runtime_smokes: paired on both arms before Tool-Eval, one active server only
throughput_screen.prompt_cache: off or unique nonce per request; prove zero prompt-cache reuse

gates.infrastructure: Exact runtime and model artifact hashes pass; Strata enumerates and the model process allocates >=1 GiB on each of the two RTX 3090s; no one-GPU fallback. Both control and candidate pass load, API and one-token smoke; otherwise stop with infrastructure status, no quality claim.
gates.quality: Complete all three paired seeds unless the preregistered safety stop fires. Mean candidate Tool-Eval score must be >= control mean - 2 points.
gates.safety: Any candidate safety_violation / unsafe action in a first completed seed that the control avoids is a no-go; stop remaining candidate evaluation immediately, preserve evidence, and do not promote. Across complete seeds, candidate may add no safety-critical regression to a control-passed case.
gates.speed: If quality/safety pass, candidate must improve median end-to-end time on paired correctly completed tasks by >=15% OR reduce output tokens on those same tasks by >=20%. Report P/D separately; no single TPS number can substitute for task success.
gates.decision: Passing this screen permits a preregistered independent coding holdout; it does not automatically replace ASTRA or change product defaults. Failure means no adoption and candidate-only model/pack/runtime cleanup after consumer checks; keep all receipts and ASTRA/SOL/PeritoSoft.

resource_policy.gpu: 2×RTX 3090, serial, one server/request stream at a time; verify compute allocation on both cards. GUI use is not an exclusion.
resource_policy.memory: No artificial RAM/swap caps; never stop on MemAvailable, RSS, or swap usage alone. Use the Q116-A2 composite global PSI candidate: warning when full avg10 >=20% OR some avg10 >=70% for 30 consecutive 10-second samples; hard stop when full avg10 >=60% OR some avg10 >=80% for 15 consecutive 10-second samples; reset the severe composite streak only when both are below threshold. Also stop on confirmed OOM, CUDA/runtime/server failure, or any GPU >=85C. Log MemAvailable, PSI, swap, OOM, VRAM and temperatures.
resource_policy.disk: Candidate, runtime, pack, Hugging Face cache, temp and run outputs on D:/ Disco local. No staging on root. Require >=180 GiB free on D before download/pack; target /media/cristian/Disco local/Models-eval/Q153-huihui-v2/.
resource_policy.cleanup: No deletion of ASTRA, SOL, MTP, PeritoSoft files, product data or prior results. On no-go, remove only Q153 candidate weights, its pack/runtime cache and transient files after confirming no open handles/processes; preserve receipts.

sheet.results_tab: Do not append to Resultados until a valid local measurement exists.
